tools.name: find_messages
tools.description: Search HourSaved's ready-to-send customer messages for small businesses by situation, for example "dog walking client cancelled last minute", "raise my prices", "client hasn't paid the invoice" or "angry one-star review". Optionally narrow to one kind of business. Returns up to 8 matches with their

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get one HourSaved message by its id (from find_messages): when to use it, when to skip it, the full prompt with [brackets] for the owner's facts, the checks to do before sending, how it was tested, and its page link.

tools.name: find_owner_stories
tools.description: Search summaries of real moments small business owners described in public (podcasts, blogs, forums), checked against the source. Returns titles, short summaries, dates, HourSaved story links and original source links. Does not return message drafts.

tools.name: find_guides
tools.description: Search HourSaved's free step-by-step guides for using AI on small business office work (email, customers, scheduling, money, planning, team, marketing). Returns titles, short summaries and links.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_messages, get_message, find_owner_stories, find_guides · Public sink: find_messages, find_guides.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_messages, get_message, find_owner_stories, find_guides · Public sink: find_messages, find_guides

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
